title: Operation Grapes of Wrath
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Operation Grapes of Wrath", at revision 1372784188, opens: "Operation Grapes of Wrath, known in Lebanon as the April Aggression, was a seventeen-day campaign of the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) against Hezbollah in 1996 which attempted to end the Iran-backed group's rocket attacks on northern Israeli civilian centres by forcing the group north of the Litani River, out of easy range of these civilian centres. Prior to the operation, Hezbollah had launched 151 rockets from Lebanon into Israel, killing two Israeli civilians and seriously wounding 24 other Israeli civilians." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1473919, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Israeli military operation against Lebanon in 1996". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
